crossRefs.keyword: with a wicked mind. Heb. in wickedness

translations.web: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
translations.bsb: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable— how much more so when brought with ill intent!
translations.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
translations.asv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination: How much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind!
